lead.hed: USNI: Abraham Lincoln makes its first full port stop of the deployment, in Thailand
lead.insight: USNI News Western Pacific Pulse, Friday: USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) pulled into Laem Chabang, Thailand, on Wednesday, its first full port visit since the deployment began. Navy still of the arrival is dated Sept. 2.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Gage Thomas · DVIDS 9904942 · Public domain · USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72) arrives in Laem Chabang, Thailand, Sept. 2, 2026.

political.hed: USNI: U.S. and Iran trade strikes along the Strait of Hormuz
political.insight: USNI News, Friday: the United States resumed attacking Iranian targets along the Strait of Hormuz this week. Central Command posted video on X saying it hit Iranian targets, including two unidentified ships. The item is a CENTCOM release plus Iranian counter-messaging.

political.hed: Defense News: Trump says Europe should repay U.S. Ukraine aid
political.insight: Defense News, Friday: President Trump said Thursday he would ask European nations to pay back the United States for military aid and munitions previously sent to Ukraine. No repayment schedule has been published.

political.hed: USNI: San Antonio sailors and Marines destroy a second suspected narco refueler
political.insight: USNI News, Thursday: sailors and Marines from USS San Antonio (LPD-17) interdicted and destroyed a second suspected narco logistics vessel in the Eastern Pacific on Wednesday, working with Ecuador as part of Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere.

tech.hed: NVIDIA agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion
tech.insight: NVIDIA, Thursday: the company agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12,930,300,000. CEO Jensen Huang wrote that more than 18 million developers use the hub and that it will stay an open, multi-cloud platform. A signed deal is still a closing process.

tech.hed: AP: Justice Department backs OpenAI against the New York Times on training data
tech.insight: Associated Press: the Trump administration told a court it backs OpenAI’s argument that training on news articles is fair use in the Times copyright case. A brief is a legal position, not a ruling.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: bad publicity can find the quiet neighbors
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Friday: “The Benefits of Bad Publicity” argues that unwanted attention can help people find like-minded neighbors who are quietly reclaiming culture. The piece is cultural argument, not a statute.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: at Reykjavik, Reagan paired principle with hard bargaining
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Friday: “Reagan and Gorbachev on the Brink” argues that at Reykjavik Reagan paired principle with strategy and hard-nosed negotiations. History essay, not a live arms-control announcement.
